name: WYSIWYP (What You See Is What You Pick)
aliases: What You See Is What You Pick
definition: A method to allow users to pick 3D positions in volumetric renderings by selecting structures they perceive, using the transfer function and data to determine opacity along the viewing direction.
summary: WYSIWYP is a volume picking technique that identifies 3D positions by detecting the largest jump in accumulated opacity along a viewing ray, distinguishing itself by focusing on interaction rather than photorealistic shading.
